notes.title: Update v240414A
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42976544/9427bf25d501614e237d99c8f44a1abc6c919976.jpg

NEW FEATURE: Damage cam. 

Shows bone breaking kicks with x-ray style and slow motion. With kick skill upgraded to the max you can use optional damage camera to show how bones of your enemies get smashed into pieces.


Other changes/fixes:

ADDED: Slider in options menu to adjust damage cam probability

+Couple of general improvements
